name: Empty Cages Collective (ECC) - small-animal / guinea pig program
neighborhoods: Williamsburg-based (11211); serves NYC + Hudson Valley via fosters
region_note: SMALL MAMMALS / 'POCKET PETS' (guinea pigs, rats, mice, hamsters, chinchillas, ferrets)
notes: All-volunteer 501(c)(3). Adopts guinea pigs only in pairs or to homes that already have one (they are social herd animals). Adoption donation from $30 single / $50 pair; $150 if spayed/neutered. Also a cat rescue (listed in the NYC cat reference). Intake: application via adopt@emptycagescollective.org
